About Ramzunā Languages

Free, personalised language education for Palestinian students — powered by volunteer educators worldwide.

Home / About
About Us

Language education for Palestinians.

Ramzunā Languages is a non-profit organisation of global educators committed to offering free online English, French and German lessons specifically for Palestinian learners residing in Palestine or having been displaced.

Artwork by Raneem (@raneem_gaza)

Our Story

Born out of a response to crisis

Ramzunā Languages was created by Juliette Delbarre, a seasoned educator, in direct response to the destruction of schools, universities and workplaces in Gaza.

Ramzunā has since expanded to be composed of Palestinian team members and educators from 19 different nationalities.

Our Mission

Language as a lifeline, not a luxury

In a time of humanitarian crisis, language is more than just a skill; it is a tool for continuity, economic survival, and personal agency.

Our mission is to support Palestinian students in overcoming the significant infrastructural and mobility barriers imposed by ongoing conflict.

Through language instruction, we equip learners with the tools to access remote work, advanced studies, academic exams, and global advocacy networks, ensuring that educational and economic opportunities remain accessible to Palestinians.

Our Values

The principles that guide everything we do.

Education — A Human Right

In line with Article 26 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, we firmly believe education is a human right, and every Palestinian should have access to it.

Empowerment

We support students in reinforcing their language skills, preparing them for further study and professional careers, and empowering them to make their voices heard.

Justice and Sumud

We value justice, dignity, humanity, peace, and the right to continue learning.

Community and Transnational Solidarity

We are strongly committed to advancing the UN Sustainable Development Goals, particularly Quality Education, Reduced Inequalities, and Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions.

Aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals

Advancing Language Instruction and Equality in Education

In 2026, our programmes have welcomed an inspiring number of women.

We are equally encouraged by the growing participation of male learners, reflecting the inclusive and dynamic nature of Ramzunā Languages.

Global Community

At Ramzunā Languages, we are proud to have teachers from around the world, empowering and contributing to our students’ success.

We are also delighted to report a 35% increase in our teaching staff for 2026.
